汤姆的生活方式(Tom's Way of Living): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:汤姆的经历、感受与成长。

Jack and Tom are preparing a report about the pedestrian street. At first, Tom found it difficult to keep the habit. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. What's more, hundreds of fans were milling around outside the concert hall.

Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Tom keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Also, the diver showed extraordinary courage during the rescue.

Little by little, things began to change. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. In fact, my classmates come from America, Japan, and Brazil.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The riverside walk has become an important part of daily life. Tom believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. In fact, the shoe store is next to the bank.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. On Sunday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. Tom plans to study English harder this term.
